comment:
Tested on staging, build v26.40.19-e435950, on 19 October 2026, signed in as Admin, window 1440 px wide.

  • Result: Passed. The build does what the test now expects, which is what the spec says.
  • Set-up: a new technician, Nora Sort QA1019 (leads no other work, nobody has reordered her work). Four work orders made in this order: S2-37437 (Zeta Hauling QA1019), S2-37438 (Alpha Freight QA1019), S2-37439 and S2-37440 (Mid Trucking QA1019). Her name was then given as lead one after another with Reassign lead technician: S2-37437, S2-37439, S2-37440, S2-37438.
  • Step 4, List with no saved sort (Customer, A to Z): S2-37438 Alpha, S2-37440 Mid (newer first), S2-37439 Mid, S2-37437 Zeta. Picture 1.
  • Step 6, Tech View, Nora Sort QA1019's group: S2-37437, S2-37439, S2-37440, S2-37438, the order the leads were given, not List's order. Picture 2, left.
  • Step 8, Board View, her column: the same order. Picture 2, right.
  • Source checked: the developer's closing note on SV-11101 (comment 78793) and SV-11312 (comment 78792) says a work order that gets its lead after it was created goes to the bottom of that technician's work. The spec "Work Orders - Board View & Tech View Display Options", version 64, says the same in S9-R14 ("A work order that gets a new lead from the Reassign lead technician dialog or from its detail page goes to the bottom of the new technician's work, for everyone at the location, in both views.") and S2-R6, and its change log records Chris Ward confirming it in version 53 (15 Oct 2026). So the developer's note is correct.
  • Not covered by this test: a work order created with its lead already set (the spec says it keeps the List's order). The New Work Order screen has no lead field, so that only happens through a split or the Schedule.

Tested on staging, build v26.40.19-31ad1e1, on 19 October 2026.

  • Result: Passed on staging under Standing Rule 131: the current PRD (v64) says a work order given its lead after it was created goes to the bottom of that technician's work, and the build does exactly that.
  • Set-up: four Approved work orders made in this order: S2-37303 (Zeta), S2-37304 (Alpha), S2-37305 (Mid), S2-37306 (Mid); their lead (ZZAUTOTEST C96929 Kit 85057) was then given in this order: S2-37303, S2-37305, S2-37306, S2-37304.   • List (default sort, customer name A to Z): S2-37304 (Alpha), S2-37306 (Mid), S2-37305 (Mid), S2-37303 (Zeta).
  • Tech View, the technician's group: S2-37303, S2-37305, S2-37306, S2-37304 - the order the leads were given. Board View, the technician's column: the same order as Tech View.
  • PRD Confluence 845185030, version 64 (16 Oct 2026), S2-R6: "A work order that gets a new lead after it was created goes to the bottom of that technician’s work instead (S9-R14)."
  • Same PRD, S9-R14: "A work order that gets a new lead from the Reassign lead technician dialog or from its detail page goes to the bottom of the new technician’s work, for everyone at the location, in both views."
  • When it changed: PRD change log, version 53, 15 Oct 2026, Chris Ward (product owner): "S9-R14 confirmed as written: a lead given after creation puts the work order at the bottom of that technician’s work (SV-11312 works as specified)."
  • Ticket SV-11101 was closed by the developer (Slavcho Mitrov, 15 Oct) as working per S9-R14. The developer's comment alone is not the reason for this pass; the PRD, written by the product owner, is.
  • The case's own expected results (written to PRD version 54) still expect Tech View and Board View to follow List's order; the QA lead will be asked to update the case.

* **Result: Passed.** When a time entry is moved to another line, the receiving line lists only the technician whose time was moved. The "Deleted user" entry seen on 15 October no longer appears, and the line the time came from goes back to Unassigned.
* This is the fix for SV-11398 (duplicate of SV-11087). The ticket's QA comment: https://shopview.atlassian.net/browse/SV-11398?focusedCommentId=78897

---

**What was checked (all Passed):**

1. The test's steps on a fresh work order, S2-36626: Tech ShopView clocked in and out on line 1, Admin moved the entry to line 2 (work order menu → Timesheets → pencil → Line → Save) and reloaded. Line 2 lists only Tech ShopView; line 1 shows Unassigned.
2. The same steps on S2-36625 (Tech ShopView) and S2-36628 (Admin ShopView): same result.
3. Admin ShopView's own entry moved from line 1 to line 2 on S2-36623: line 2 lists only Admin ShopView.
4. The entry moved back from line 2 to line 1: both lines exactly as before, no extra rows.
5. The technician already had time on line 2, then line 1's entry was moved there: line 2 keeps one row with both times (0.05 h + 0.02 h = 0.07 h).
6. The move made from Reports → Timesheet Activities instead of the work order (S2-36625): same result.

The old example S2-35973 still shows "Deleted user": that entry was made on 15 October, before the fix, and the developer noted on SV-11087 that rows made before the fix are kept.

---

**How to see it:** on staging, Admin, open work order S2-36629 (two approved lines, nobody on them). On line 1 click Start in the Labor row, wait a minute, click Stop, type a note and click Clock Out. Open the menu at the top right of the tabs → Timesheets (1) → pencil on your row → Line 2 → Save. Reload the Lines tab: line 2 lists only your name and there is no "Deleted user".

**Attached:** before-vs-after picture, the steps, the other checks, and a screen recording of the test on S2-36626.
